_comment_README: Mirror of vercel.json's headers (keep the two in step). HTML and every script and stylesheet revalidate on every load (max-age=0, must-revalidate): their addresses never change, and a deploy must never meet an old app.js or home.css. Pictures and fonts keep their addresses when they are re-taken, so they get an hour, then up to a week served while a fresh copy is fetched (stale-while-revalidate). Only vendor/<name>-<version>/ carries its version in its address, so only it is kept for a year (immutable): a new version goes in a new folder. The security headers and the CSP are vercel.json's (frame-ancestors and frame-src keep 'self').

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com https://plausible.io; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://cxnotrikxvzncupswvio.supabase.co https://toolbox.marketingtools.apple.com; media-src 'self' blob: https://cxnotrikxvzncupswvio.supabase.co; connect-src 'self' https://cxnotrikxvzncupswvio.supabase.co wss://cxnotrikxvzncupswvio.supabase.co https://*.lemonsqueezy.com https://plausible.io; frame-src 'self' https://*.lemonsqueezy.com; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

_notes_after_paste: 1. frame-ancestors 'self' (not 'none') replaces X-Frame-Options while still allowing the in-app test harness: admin.html embeds tests.html, which embeds athlete.html?demo=1 — all same-origin. frame-src 'self' is needed for the same reason (admin embeds tests). 'self' still blocks all cross-origin framing, so clickjacking protection is intact.

2. The 'unsafe-inline' for script-src exists because index.html has inline theme script and inline onclick handlers (openSignupModal etc). Removing it would require refactoring those out into addEventListener. Acceptable for launch but worth a follow-up.
3. connect-src includes wss:// for Supabase realtime subscriptions — drop it if you don't use realtime.
4. If you add Plausible/PostHog/GA, you'll need to extend script-src and connect-src.
5. Test after deploying: open devtools console on every page and check for CSP violation errors. Common breaks: external images, embedded YouTube, Stripe Elements. Adjust allowlist accordingly.
6. Verify HSTS only AFTER you're certain you'll stay on HTTPS — once preloaded, hard to undo.
